new_deal_candidates.buyer: Apollo Global Management via Eagle Bidco Ltd
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Large UK/European consumer travel brand. easyJet states that, as of 6 August 2026, easyJet and Apollo via Eagle Bidco Ltd agreed terms for a recommended cash acquisition to be implemented by scheme of arrangement; scheme document publication deadline was extended to on or before 15 October 2026.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: easyJet is present in known research candidates but not in known deals; this is a material ownership-change lead.

new_deal_candidates.buyer: Naspers Limited via Prosus and MIH
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Major Romanian consumer e-commerce platform. European Commission decision of 6 August 2026 says Naspers, parent of Prosus, would acquire sole control of Dante International S.A. / eMAG, which was previously jointly controlled by Iulian Gabriel Stanciu and Naspers via Prosus/MIH.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not found in known deals list. Buyer is not USA/China/Europe but deal is a major European consumer marketplace ownership change.

new_deal_candidates.buyer: Partners Group, with Eurazeo retaining significant minority stake
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Fast-growing French consumer beauty and wellness brand. Partners Group announced on 6 August 2026 that it entered exclusivity to acquire Aroma-Zone from Eurazeo; Eurazeo says Partners Group would acquire a majority stake and Eurazeo would reinvest/retain a significant minority. EU OJ prior notification dated 27 August 2026 identifies Case M.12613, PG / EURAZEO / AROMA-ZONE / LH 91, for joint control.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not found in known deals list; official company and EU notification sources support pending transaction.

new_deal_candidates.buyer: The Platform Group SE & Co. KGaA
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: German consumer furniture marketplace/resale platform. The Platform Group announced on 6 August 2026 that it signed an asset purchase agreement to acquire Cocoli.com assets and expand its furniture marketplace business.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not found in known deals list. Medium confidence because the accessible source is an issuer press release distributed through WebDisclosure rather than the company's own IR page.

new_deal_candidates.buyer: Katjes International via Katjes Quiet Luxury
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Well-known German luxury sportswear/fashion brand. Katjes International announced on 1 August 2025 that its wholly-owned subsidiary Katjes Quiet Luxury signed an agreement to acquire 60% of Willy Bogner GmbH, with closing expected in September 2025.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: High-confidence missed deal from 2015 onward; not found in known deals list.
